Uses the standard AES forward S-box (256-byte table at .rdata 0x140005000, starts 63 7C 77 7B F2 6B...) but is NOT real AES (no ShiftRows/MixColumns/key schedule). Implemented in the block routine at 0x140001480 and the buffer/ECB driver at 0x140001530.
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded plaintext ASCII string embedded in the .rdata section at VA 0x140005100 (file offset 0x2900), passed directly to the decrypt routine; the round constant multiplier 0x1B is an immediate in the code
